title: 401 Unauthorized
description:
RFC 9110 §15.5.2; class client_error; engine use: used.
Trigger: A protected route received no credential or an invalid/expired bearer token.
Content: application/problem+json (ErrorEnvelope).
Required headers: WWW-Authenticate.
Cache-Control: no-store; retry: never.

x-response-contract.trigger: A protected route received no credential or an invalid/expired bearer token.

WWW-Authenticate.notes: Add error="invalid_token" for malformed or expired credentials; never echo the token.

examples.title: Unauthorized
examples.detail: A protected route received no credential or an invalid/expired bearer token.
